name: mcp-pdf
scope: Current remote MCP and cloud STDIO plus PDF; durable core, native sessions, authorization, backup and legacy records remain shared.

policy.mixedFiles: Retain the whole file. No line-level ignores, name-based excludes or reduced thresholds.
policy.discovery: Every discovered path requires one explicit record for its kind. Reject missing, duplicate, stale paths or missing owners/reasons before activating this proposal.
policy.historicalData: Retain all current source, historical tests, catalog releases and accepted records. The existing full entry remains available.
policy.activation: Root approved exactly four pure client SSH runtime files and three historical tests. Other authored files remain enabled or shared.

reasons.mcp-current: Current remote MCP or cloud STDIO composition and its behavior tests; keep the complete file under all four per-file 100% metrics.
reasons.ssh-client-retained: Not reachable from the current native client entry after SSH construction, injection, list loading and rendering were removed; retain source and historical tests in the full corpus.
reasons.client-shared: Current native Skills/PDF UI, account session source, locale, styling or common transport; retain complete mixed files under all four per-file 100% metrics.
reasons.core-shared: Retained in current Host/Platform/Runner and durable data or execution support until Root admits an explicit dependency removal; filename or disabled availability alone grants no exclusion.
reasons.legacy-shared: Released legacy records, data conversion, reconciliation and tombstones remain owned and validated even when new feature exposure is deferred.
reasons.office-shared: Authored Office support remains in both current and full corpora pending explicit profile and dependency verification; no Office filename exclusion is admitted.
reasons.assets-shared: Native execution, sandbox and packaged support assets remain enumerated and validated; no threshold or discovery rule changes.
reasons.gate-shared: Tooling, manifests and documentation remain enumerated by the current and full entries; the named selection is shared by CLI, Vitest, coverage, native collection and CI without changing quality thresholds.
reasons.legacy-mcp-current-shared: Current shared legacy MCP catalog, draft, history and concurrency migration required by the core/MCP scope; retain the complete file in both current and full corpora.
reasons.native-runtime-s3: Original native tenant Profile, runtime account authority, PG Session ownership, registered tools and their behavior tests belong to the shared native runtime slice.
